$comment: Registry of every example: the gallery (index.html) renders it, build_examples.sh / deploy.sh / etc/publish_new_version.sh iterate it. `version` is the git tag the StackBlitz links open; the release script bumps it. Order within a dimension is the order the gallery lists; the first entry of `physics` / `visual` is the default backend.

examples.title: Primitives
examples.description: A level built from JSON: primitive shapes rain onto a floor, with an orbit camera and a kill-floor trigger wired through a blueprint.

examples.title: GLB loader
examples.description: Loads GLB models carrying physics metadata from the engine's Blender exporter and keeps spawning them into a scene.

examples.title: Collision groups
examples.description: Collision filtering: bodies and triggers that only interact with their own groups.

examples.title: Collision groups pool
examples.description: Hundreds of balls on stacked kinematic floors, where each floor only ever carries its own collision group.

examples.title: Raycast vehicle
examples.description: A drivable raycast vehicle, ported from the ammo.js vehicle demo to the engine's vehicle API.

examples.title: Player character
examples.description: Animated third-person character controller over a GLB level, with on-screen mobile controls.

examples.title: Portal room
examples.description: First-person character, grabbable props and positional sound.

examples.title: Shooter
examples.description: Free-fly camera shooting balls through a textured physics scene.
